desired_yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: redis-prod-replicas
  namespace: redis-prod
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: redis-prod
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: Helm
    app.kubernetes.io/name: redis
    app.kubernetes.io/version: 8.10.2
    helm.sh/chart: redis-28.3.1
    app.kubernetes.io/component: replica
    environment: prod
spec:
  replicas: 0
  revisionHistoryLimit: 10
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/instance: redis-prod
      app.kubernetes.io/name: redis
      app.kubernetes.io/component: replica
  serviceName: redis-prod-headless
  updateStrategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/instance: redis-prod
        app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: Helm
        app.kubernetes.io/name: redis
        app.kubernetes.io/version: 8.10.2
        helm.sh/chart: redis-28.3.1
        app.kubernetes.io/component: replica
      annotations:
        checksum/configmap: 62ff2843192643ad74a96fbad607a0b92db3dc81d3a369deaa3fb9aebbd24ddc
        checksum/health: a2fc61ae99390643dac0673ed97203805136d4460b2319e7beff10546c1e1140
        checksum/scripts: b684910b6d9af39a1bc17e02060275d7cef71b74ad8bc814b7f9080079953979
        checksum/secret: 1c372d8461865400fce117396856b7138b639309df0bebfcd851cbef36a9af5e
    spec:
      securityContext:
        fsGroup: 1001
        fsGroupChangePolicy: Always
        supplementalGroups: []
        sysctls: []
      serviceAccountName: redis-prod-replica
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      affinity:
        podAffinity: null
        podAntiAffinity:
          preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
          - podAffinityTerm:
              labelSelector:
                matchLabels:
                  app.kubernetes.io/instance: redis-prod
                  app.kubernetes.io/name: redis
                  app.kubernetes.io/component: replica
              topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
            weight: 1
        nodeAffinity: null
      enableServiceLinks: true
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30
      containers:
      - name: redis
        image: registry-1.docker.io/bitnami/redis:8.10.2
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        securityContext:
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          runAsGroup: 1001
          runAsNonRoot: true
          runAsUser: 1001
          seLinuxOptions: {}
          seccompProfile:
            type: RuntimeDefault
        command:
        - /bin/bash
        args:
        - -ec
        - /opt/bitnami/scripts/start-scripts/start-replica.sh
        env:
        - name: BITNAMI_DEBUG
          value: 'false'
        - name: REDIS_REPLICATION_MODE
          value: replica
        - name: REDIS_MASTER_HOST
          value: redis-prod-master-0.redis-prod-headless.redis-prod.svc.cluster.local
        - name: REDIS_MASTER_PORT_NUMBER
          value: '6379'
        - name: OPENSSL_FIPS
          value: 'yes'
        - name: ALLOW_EMPTY_PASSWORD
          value: 'no'
        - name: REDIS_PASSWORD_FILE
          value: /opt/bitnami/redis/secrets/redis-password
        - name: REDIS_MASTER_PASSWORD_FILE
          value: /opt/bitnami/redis/secrets/redis-password
        - name: REDIS_TLS_ENABLED
          value: 'no'
        - name: REDIS_PORT
          value: '6379'
        ports:
        - name: redis
          containerPort: 6379
        startupProbe:
          failureThreshold: 22
          initialDelaySeconds: 10
          periodSeconds: 10
          successThreshold: 1
          timeoutSeconds: 5
          tcpSocket:
            port: redis
        livenessProbe:
          initialDelaySeconds: 20
          periodSeconds: 5
          timeoutSeconds: 6
          successThreshold: 1
          failureThreshold: 5
          exec:
            command:
            - /bin/bash
            - -ec
            - /health/ping_liveness_local_and_master.sh 5
        readinessProbe:
          initialDelaySeconds: 20
          periodSeconds: 5
          timeoutSeconds: 2
          successThreshold: 1
          failureThreshold: 5
          exec:
            command:
            - /bin/bash
            - -ec
            - /health/ping_readiness_local_and_master.sh 1
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 150m
            ephemeral-storage: 2Gi
            memory: 192Mi
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            ephemeral-storage: 50Mi
            memory: 128Mi
        volumeMounts:
        - name: start-scripts
          mountPath: /opt/bitnami/scripts/start-scripts
        - name: health
          mountPath: /health
        - name: redis-password
          mountPath: /opt/bitnami/redis/secrets/
        - name: redis-data
          mountPath: /data
        - name: config
          mountPath: /opt/bitnami/redis/mounted-etc
        - name: empty-dir
          mountPath: /opt/bitnami/redis/etc
          subPath: app-conf-dir
        - name: empty-dir
          mountPath: /tmp
          subPath: tmp-dir
      volumes:
      - name: start-scripts
        configMap:
          name: redis-prod-scripts
          defaultMode: 493
      - name: health
        configMap:
          name: redis-prod-health
          defaultMode: 493
      - name: redis-password
        secret:
          secretName: redis-prod
          items:
          - key: redis-password
            path: redis-password
      - name: config
        configMap:
          name: redis-prod-configuration
      - name: empty-dir
        emptyDir: {}
  volumeClaimTemplates:
  - apiVersion: v1
    kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
    metadata:
      name: redis-data
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/instance: redis-prod
        app.kubernetes.io/name: redis
        app.kubernetes.io/component: replica
    spec:
      accessModes:
      - ReadWriteOnce
      resources:
        requests:
          storage: 8Gi
